snippet.title: Tides of Annihilation | First Story Trailer: “Beneath the Veil”
snippet.description:
The Fog veils the world, hiding the truths buried beneath.

Follow Gwendolyn as she comes face to face with a legendary figure and uncovers a past long hidden from the world.

This brand new Tides of Annihilation trailer features Angela Sant'Albano's debut as the voice of Gwendolyn.

Inspired by Arthurian legend and developed by Eclipse Glow Games, Tides of Annihilation is coming to Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation, and Xbox.

Wishlist now.

🔗 Steam: static-global.playtoa.com/link/steam/link-global-30.html
🔗 PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10011825
🔗 Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/tides-of-annihilation/9PD71JKM2S91/0010
🔗 Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/tides-of-annihilation-27dbb7
